name: Config B simulator scenario bank
status: recorded 2026-11-10 for owner review; not frozen until the pre-registration amendment
description: 50 episodes for each of five fold seeds (not 250 independent seeds). CAGE 4 scripted red (FiniteStateRedAgent) against sleeping blue. Not a real-world attacker population and not an independent validation set.

configuration.blue_policy: Sleep for all five blue agents

outcome_rules: each executed action once; in-progress steps (logged as Sleep) never; ExploitRemoteService with no concrete exploit = O4 unreachable, reported separately

reproducibility.behavioural: seed 0, 2 and 3 behavioural counts (red actions, successes, blue events, reward) equal the spike's runs exactly
reproducibility.byte_for_byte: seed 0 trajectory hash equals the spike's final-probe hash (724e864d...); seeds 2 and 3 differ from the spike's hashes because those runs predate sub_action logging, a change in what is logged, not in behaviour
